attrs.evidence: bridge/film_check.mjs 25/25. church_exp_2_2 -- the corpus vector whose retracted AST scheduling relation reached FALSE QUIESCENCE at step 15 -- emits 21 chained native frames covering APP-LAM, APP-SUP, DUP-LAM, DUP-SUP=, DUP-SUP!, DUP-VAR and DUP-APP across t:, d: and v: loci and BOTH semantic planes, and replaySemFilm accepts the chain on FloatRt and on the adversarial DescFloatRt. The endpoints are the corpus vector's own initial state and normal form, which the 48/48 bridge gate had already shown C and JS agree on byte-for-byte, so the new claim is exactly the 21 TRANSITIONS between them. THE COVERAGE ASSERTION IS DERIVED FROM THE FILM (which rules occur, which locus families occur, which planes occur) and every forgery index is FOUND rather than written down. Seven new forgeries on the new surfaces, each RE-COMMITTED so it dies on the calculus rather than on bookkeeping: D-1 a d: index no live cell carries (sem-locus-not-enabled), D-2 a v: path extended past any application (sem-locus-not-enabled), D-3 DUP-SUP= relabelled as its sibling DUP-SUP! (sem-rule-mismatch), D-4 APP-SUP relabelled APP-LAM (sem-rule-mismatch), D-5 a COLLAPSE frame claiming INTERACT (sem-plane-mismatch -- the first hybrid-plane film, so the first one in which the partition is forgeable at all), D-6 the honest film stopped one frame early with its terminal HONESTLY RECOMPUTED so every bookkeeping check passes (sem-false-normal-form -- the historical disease of this exact fixture, now refused by the contract instead of discovered by an audit), and D-7 a locus naming a DIFFERENT REDEX THAT REALLY IS LIVE AND ENABLED WITH THE SAME RULE, which gets past enabledness entirely and dies on the post-state (sem-post-mismatch) -- the only forgery that distinguishes 'the locus names A redex' from 'the locus names THE redex'. era-declared-in-pool-and-in-no-frame asserts the ERA rules are in the declared pool and in no frame, and emitter-refuses-out-of-scope probes both with minimal terms. THE MEASUREMENT THAT PRECEDED ALL OF IT: bridge/measure_compare.mjs, non-gating, 27/27 fixtures agree -- the whole conformance corpus plus the film fixtures, with church_exp_3_3 at 91 frames and 87 dup-plane loci. It was shown to be able to FAIL before its agreement was used: three perturbed C builds differ on 8, 12 and 2 fixtures respectively, the locus-order perturbation reporting 'frame 3 locus: JS d:0 vs C d:1' -- a real dup, correctly enumerated, named by the wrong index. AND THE COMPARATOR'S FIRST FIND WAS A DEFECT IN THE COMPARATOR: it read the JS terminal state AFTER readback, which fires rules into the same runtime, so it measured a state the film never reached; church_exp_2_2 hid this because its readback fires nothing, and the corpus is what exposed it.

Kept as history and not withdrawn: nothing it claims is wrong, and it is the record of the round in which the FLOAT PLANE was built and measured before it was asserted -- the two traversal orders, the projection lookup, the 27-fixture pre-assertion diff and the comparator's find against itself. What @3 changes is the SCOPE sentence: @2's 'APP-ERA and DUP-ERA are enumerated and refused by name' was true when written and became a RATCHET the moment their witnesses were built, which is the third time a scope predicate in this law line has had to move.
attrs.statement: THE EXECUTION PLANE ORIGINATES EVIDENCE FOR THE INTERACTION-NET DYNAMICS THEMSELVES, rather than the governance plane reconstructing it around the execution plane afterwards. For a frozen fixture, the native C runtime independently emits a chained semantic film whose per-frame pre-state, enabled rule, PLANE, canonical locus and post-state, and whose terminal, are accepted by the existing TRVM-SEMFILM-v1.1 contract WITHOUT normalization or translation of meaning -- the law kernel's own replaySemFilm, imported unmodified, replaying on a fresh runtime of two different allocator classes. @1 SCOPED THIS TO THE APP PLANE and that was the whole frontier: application of a lambda at a tree locus is the part of the calculus a term-rewriting relation already models. @2 IS THE FLOAT PLANE. Enumeration covers the root tree AND EVERY LIVE DUP CELL; loci are canonical in three families -- t: a structural path, d: a DISCOVERY INDEX over live cells, v: a discovery index AND a path into a cell's value -- and the rules with a native handler are APP-LAM, APP-SUP, DUP-LAM, DUP-SUP=, DUP-SUP!, DUP-VAR and DUP-APP. THE TWO ORDERS ARE DIFFERENT ORDERS AND BOTH ARE LOAD-BEARING: the kernel enumerates live cells right-to-left (liveHeap pushes children forward) and INDEXES loci left-to-right (liveDiscoveryOrder pushes them reversed), so one order decides which redex is leftmost and the other decides what number its locus carries; collapsing either onto the other produces a locus that names a real redex which is not the redex that fired. SCOPE, CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED AND STATED AS REFUSALS: APP-ERA and DUP-ERA are ENUMERATED -- so that 'no enabled work' cannot silently mean 'no work of the kinds I implement', which is how a false normal form is written down -- and REFUSED BY NAME (film-era-rule-not-implemented) rather than fired, because neither has a witness; the church_exp_2_2 measurement is what established that this corpus fires NEITHER, correcting a plan that had expected only DUP-ERA to be missing. A step budget reached while work remains is a TYPED REFUSAL (film-budget-exhausted) and never a terminal. The terminal is concluded only after a FRESH FULL-POOL ENUMERATION returns empty. AND THE RELATION WAS MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS ASSERTED. The C reducer was built with a non-gating --measure formatter and diffed against the independently measured kernel relation over the whole 24-vector corpus and the film fixtures before one conformance assertion existed; NO EXPECTED TABLE APPEARS IN THE EMITTER OR IN THE COMPARATOR, because a conformance theorem whose expected values were transcribed from the other implementation is a TRANSCRIPTION THEOREM. ic32 CANNOT SUBSTITUTE A DUP BY NAME and that cost is representational, not semantic: heap[D] is the cell's value before the rule fires and the other side's substitution afterwards, so a dup is fired from a DEMANDED SIDE and the demanded projection is replaced where it stands, found by a walk over reachable slots that REFUSES (film-projection-not-unique) rather than choosing if it is not unique. The rules fired are ic32's own fire() and app_sup(), unedited. THE TWO TRANSITION SYSTEMS STAY SEPARATE (film_planes): the TRVM calculus film is pre-state -> (rule + locus) -> post-state over the ic32 interaction-net relation, and the derivation evidence relation is DeriveRequest -> evaluate -> DeriveResult; what is shared is HOST INFRASTRUCTURE, not semantics. Film provenance uses the same discipline as derivation.implementation-provenance@4 -- shared ObservedExecutionHost, immutable catalog entry, hash-then-launch, observation keyed over the whole emission -- and REPLAY AND PROVENANCE ARE REPORTED SEPARATELY, because a film can be semantically perfect and its claimed provenance false.
